notes.title: Improved Gameplay and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
We're excited to release our latest patch update for Fright Knight Legend, featuring several improvements and bug fixes. We've fixed a bug that previously prevented players from running when their stamina was out, so you can now sprint to your heart's content. We've also added support for 5:4, 16:9, and 21:9 screen sizes, giving you more options to customize your gameplay experience. Additionally, we've resolved a bug in the Grasslands BOSS level that previously kept some players from progressing. We hope you enjoy these changes and look forward to your continued support for Fright Knight Legend!

Hint: When you're playing the game and low on lives & energy, use this code to get a pick me up!

Pause the game and the press
JJJBBBJJJ
J=Jump
B=Block

You will then have your lives, energy and stamina refilled.

notes.title: Enemy AI patch
notes.notes: Updated the Enemy AI so when the player gets knocked down, the player is not ganged up on as easily.

notes.title: Release date set for Dec 14th
notes.notes:
Fright Knight Legend has a new launch date of December 14th. Make sure to wishlist on Steam so you get notified the moment it comes out.
